bullets.text: The 93.4 combined ratio was very acceptable, reflecting expected seasonality. Aggregate storm damage of $125 million was manageable within current pricing. Results were similar to Q1, and focus remains on profitable growth.

Aggregate storm damage reached $125 million amid severe weather. Storms amplified the role Progressive plays after losses, with impressive deployment logistics and employee commitment to go where customers need them most.

Written premium grew 3% YOY; Commercial Auto written premium turned positive at +3%, aided by prior rate actions earning through and selected pockets of increased demand; average written premium remained flat to lower.

Policy counts grew 5%. Flat to lower average written premium per policy, with lower frequency and aging vehicles contributing, puts added emphasis on expense management, retention efforts, and acquisition spending yield expectations.

Progressive highlighted internal commitment to mobile technology, noting a small but rapid increase in mobile payments. It outlined a multi-quarter feature roadmap, sold its first mobile policy in July, and subsequently sold many more.

Snapshot rollout continued, with discounts available in 38 markets. Consumer acceptance was consistent with expectations, and increased data validated research. Early acceptance was greater with Direct customers, and independent agents showed increasing interest.

Significant state rate activity included increases reflecting expected loss costs. Several large personal auto states continued returning to health in profit and new business growth following adjustments for emerging personal injury protection trends.

Sequential changes in frequency and severity from Q1 were unremarkable, excluding comprehensive storm coverage; protracted reductions in accident frequency continued contributing to flat or declining average written premiums.

New television creative launched to position Progressive for consumers preferring to bundle home and auto. Marketing support for Snapshot rolled out following commentary provided at the June 17th Investor Relations presentation.

Company actively seeks greater growth; overall plan remains anchored on gaining traction in emerging growth initiatives, continuous product improvements, and capitalizing on the healthier outlook across several large states.
